means: The mouth is shut, lips together. A danbooru tag, and one of the few face tags that is as reliable as a count tag.
does: Shuts the jaw and takes teeth out of the face, which quietly raises the composure of the whole frame - a closed mouth is most of what makes a character read as controlled rather than reacting. It is also a reliability tag, and this is the part worth internalising: leave the mouth unspecified and the model picks, and it picks a slight smile far more often than a serious scene wants. That is the mechanism behind this project's measured failure where a scene set to melancholy and defeat rendered the character smiling. Naming the mouth shut is the cheap fix that the abstract mood word could not buy.
reach_for_it: every held, controlled or silent beat - and as the default on any face you have not deliberately opened
used_in: the mouth field of ten emotion presets - neutral, cold, determined, focus, pride, resolve, shame, smug, suspicion and tender - plus her-name.json and puddle.json, and every non-shouting character beat in derby-ep1
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
